title: 5.7.3 Sub-build: A word that floats and dies
description: Click and a small word pops up, floats, and removes itself. Build the popup alone, before it goes on a bumper.

steps.title: Run it first
steps.instructions: Click the canvas: nothing appears. The canvas is empty on purpose.

steps.title: Make one on a click
steps.instructions: On `mouse.presses()`, make a small sprite at the pointer with `collider = 'none'`, give it `.text = '+5'`, a colour, and a small upward `vel.y`.
hints: `collider = 'none'` lets anything pass through it and switches its gravity off, so it floats instead of falling.
`mouse.presses()` is true on one frame per click; `pressing()` is true while held.

steps.title: Give it a lifetime
steps.instructions: Add `pop.life = 40;` on the line after it is made. It counts down one per frame and moSHion deletes the sprite at 0.
hints: If popups pile up at the bottom, they have no `.life` or the `.life` is on another sprite.
30 is half a second, 60 is a second.

requirements.title: A sprite is made on the click
requirements.description: A new Sprite is made inside a mouse test, not every frame. Help: 5.7.2 (Worked Example: A "+5" that floats away)
requirements.hint: if (mouse.presses()) { const pop = new Sprite(mouse.x, mouse.y, 28); }

requirements.title: It wears words
requirements.description: The new sprite gets .text, so it shows a word or a number. Help: 5.7.1 (Reading: Words on a sprite, and sprites that run out)

requirements.title: It removes itself
requirements.description: The sprite gets a .life above 0. Help: 5.7.1 (Reading: Words on a sprite, and sprites that run out)

aiCheck.rubricTitle: What the AI read in your code
aiCheck.prompt: The student wrote a short moSHion sketch for "Sub-build: A word that floats and dies". The task: on a mouse press make a small sprite at the pointer with collider 'none', give it .text with a short word or number, a colour and a small upward vel.y, and give it a .life above 0 so it removes itself. This is a sub-build: a small isolated program whose only job is this one mechanic, so judge the mechanic itself and not style. Accept any variable names, helper functions, arrow functions, ternaries and semicolons. A line that only exists in a comment or a string does not count. moSHion facts: colliding(b) is 0 while apart and counts frames while touching, so an if on it alone is true every frame of a touch; a stored "last frame" value makes it true once. .life = n counts down one per frame and deletes the sprite at 0. A sprite with collider 'none' is passed through and has its gravity off. loadSound(path) in setup() and sound.play() where the event happens; a browser will not play sound before the student's first click or key. Write short, plain notes for a 14-year-old, name the student's own line when something is missing, and never write corrected code.

rubric.title: One per click
rubric.description: The sprite is made inside a mouse test (presses, or pressing gated), not every frame.

rubric.title: It floats
rubric.description: collider = 'none' and a negative vel.y, or a position raised every frame.

rubric.title: It dies
rubric.description: A .life above 0, or a countdown that deletes it.
